description: Guard hooks for dangerous commands and secrets, backed by native deny rules.

optOut.description: Deny rules (such as Bash(rm -rf:*)) and guards (guard-bash, guard-secrets) removed on purpose: the kit does not write them, and doctor and update stop warning about them.

blockAiAttribution.description: guard-bash denies AI co-author trailers and Generated with lines in commit and PR commands.

blockNoVerify.description: guard-bash denies skipping git hooks: --no-verify, HUSKY=0 and pointing core.hooksPath elsewhere.

denyCommands.description: Commands guard-bash denies, each as its program and words, such as terraform destroy, wherever they appear in a command line.
